text: 反驳不了，因为卖yin必然存在，无论怎么去挤这块海绵，都挤不净
en: You can't refute it, because prostitution inevitably exists; no matter how you squeeze this sponge, you can never squeeze it dry.

text: 这种外卖你怎么管，人家就愿意1000块钱一碗牛肉饭，美女配送你管得着？
en: How are you going to regulate this kind of takeaway? People are happy to pay 1,000 yuan for a bowl of beef rice with a beautiful woman delivering it — is that any of your business?

text: 人家干了啥你能监控吗，1000块钱上门做饭的丝袜美女，你管得着吗，人家吃完饭干啥谁知道？
en: Can you monitor what they actually do? A beautiful woman in stockings who comes to your home to cook for 1,000 yuan — is that any of your business? Who knows what they get up to after the meal?

text: 管得太宽容易误伤无辜。
en: Regulating too broadly easily harms the innocent.

text: 在一个 组织介绍卖淫 起刑10年-无期 ，强迫卖淫 起刑只有5-10年，收买并强奸被拐卖妇女甚至不一定能公诉 的性专营 封建社会。
en: In a feudal, sex-franchised society where organising and procuring prostitution carries a starting sentence of ten years to life, forced prostitution carries only a starting sentence of five to ten years, and even buying and raping a trafficked woman may not necessarily be prosecuted.

text: 有人觉得我不懂法律，我笑他不懂严打，（1991年关于严禁卖淫嫖娼的决定）
en: Some think I don't understand the law; I laugh at them for not understanding the crackdown (the 1991 Decision on Strictly Prohibiting Prostitution and Whoring).

text: 任何 反驳 支持卖淫合法 的话语，都是苍白无力的。
en: Any rhetoric that rebuts support for the legalisation of prostitution is utterly feeble.

text: 我觉得最有群众基础的是 卖淫非法扩大化
en: I think what has the broadest popular basis is the broadening of prostitution's criminalisation.

text: 现在的核心矛盾在于 卖淫非法 而包养合法
en: The core contradiction now is that prostitution is illegal while keeping a mistress is legal.

text: 这是欺负穷人 维护富人 非常不公平
en: This bullies the poor and protects the rich; it is utterly unfair.

text: 想解决这个不公平 卖淫合法化 显然争议很多
en: To resolve this unfairness, legalising prostitution clearly carries many controversies.

text: 但是可以换个思路 把包养和约炮也都认定为卖淫
en: But we can change our approach and classify both mistress-keeping and casual hookups as prostitution as well.

text: 持结婚证做爱 无证性行为一律视为非法
en: Sex is only permitted with a marriage certificate; any sexual act without a licence is deemed illegal.

text: 有劳保会说 那样彩礼岂不是上天了
en: Labour-protection advocates would say, wouldn't that send bride prices soaring to the heavens?

text: 但我觉得恰恰是这样 断绝了女性获得婚外性的渠道 性需求对于男女都是一样的
en: But I think it is precisely this that cuts off women's access to extra-marital sex; sexual need is the same for both men and women.

text: 众所周知 现在的环境是 5%的alpha男通过包养和约炮占有了95%的女性
en: As everyone knows, the current environment is that 5% of alpha males possess 95% of women through mistress-keeping and casual hookups.

text: 一旦卖淫违法扩大化 真正受打击的是这5% 而不是更普遍的普通男性 我相信普通男性相反会因此受益
en: Once the criminalisation of prostitution is expanded, it is precisely these 5% who are truly hit, not the more ordinary everyday men; I believe ordinary men would instead benefit from this.

text: 有一件事我不能理解，面对拐卖孩子的时候，他们嚷嚷着要重刑威慑，而不是支持人口买卖。
en: There is one thing I cannot understand: when confronted with child trafficking, they shout for heavy sentences as deterrence, rather than supporting the buying and selling of people.

text: 面对强奸的时候，他们嚷嚷着要卖淫合法，而不是加重刑罚。
en: When confronted with rape, they shout for the legalisation of prostitution, rather than increasing the punishment.

text: 那婚前交往过5个女朋友的男的，和婚前嫖过5个妓女的男的，你能接受哪一个？
en: Then, a man who dated five girlfriends before marriage, and a man who visited five prostitutes before marriage — which of the two can you accept?

text: 这两个男人都和你不认识的五个女性发生了关系，嫖客还戴套，还很认真的付了钱，还不留感情。
en: Both these men had relations with five women you don't know; the john even wore a condom, paid in earnest, and formed no emotional attachment.

text: 卖淫这件事，合法和自愿只能占一个。
en: With prostitution, legal and voluntary can only occupy one side.

text: 如果合法，有太多做法可以让人无论自愿与否都陷入卖淫行业。
en: If it is legal, there are far too many schemes that can drag people into the prostitution industry whether they are willing or not.

text: 随便举个例子，放一笔校园贷，还不上怎么办？
en: Take a random example: extend a campus loan; what happens if it can't be repaid?

text: 简单，我这边有一份工作，不用费力，你只需要往床上一躺，贷自然就还上了。
en: Simple — I have a job here that takes no effort; you just lie down on the bed, and the loan naturally gets repaid.

text: 不想去坐台？
en: Don't want to sit at the bar?

text: 好办，我们还有次一档的，你去拍fc2小视频也是来钱的，再不行你哪怕先在前台站两天，当当收银接待，让姐妹们传帮带一下，无非还得慢点，多吃几期利息，也不是不能接受，大不了借新还旧是不是？
en: Easy — we have a tier lower down; you could go shoot fc2 short videos for money too. If that still won't do, you can even stand at the front desk for a couple of days first, doing cashier and reception, and let the sisters pass on their experience and mentor you. It just means repaying a bit slower and eating a few more rounds of interest — not unacceptable, worst case you borrow new to repay old, right?

text: 整个过程合理合法，你还上这笔，尝到甜头了，你还有那个自制力去不借下一笔吗？
en: The whole process is reasonable and legal; you repay this sum, get a taste of the benefit — do you still have the self-control not to borrow the next round?

text: 多来几次，总有人到最后就赖在这上面了。
en: A few more times, and there will always be someone who ends up hooked on it.

text: 广撒网多捞鱼，上百万女大学生人人借一笔，解决多少卖淫行业人员缺口。
en: Cast a wide net to catch more fish; if millions of female university students each borrow a sum, how many of the prostitution industry's staffing shortages would that solve.

text: 而且，一旦卖淫合法，甚至就算是真正自愿卖淫的人群都会受到挤压。
en: Moreover, once prostitution is legalised, even genuinely voluntary prostitutes would be squeezed.

text: 成规模的黄色资本对于个体户而言具有巨大的宣传优势，规模优势，标准化服务优势，楼下的一家连锁制妓院，能从价格，服务，人员配置等一系列角度碾压曾经单打独斗的楼凤和推特福利姬，只要给够钱，他们甚至连男人都能帮你找。
en: Large-scale porn capital holds enormous promotional, scale, and standardised-service advantages over solo operators. A chain brothel downstairs can crush the once lone-wolf loufeng and Twitter welfare-girls from every angle — price, service, staffing, and so on — and as long as they are paid enough, they can even find you a man.

text: 自此，任何以个体户形式单打独斗的自愿卖淫者都会从需求的层面上遭到最残酷的碾压，一贯以来都存在的，连政策都无法扫尽也无法真正惩戒的个体户黄色产业经营者会直接在大资本的面前灰飞烟灭。
en: From then on, any voluntarily practising prostitute operating solo as an individual will be most cruelly crushed at the level of demand. The individual operators of the porn industry who have always existed — whom even policy could neither sweep away nor truly punish — will simply be wiped out before big capital.

text: 而如果这些人打不过就加入呢？
en: And if these people, unable to win, simply join them?

text: 那不好意思，这下轮到黄色产业资本反过来审查他们够不够格了，你工资要多少？
en: Well, sorry, but now it is the porn-industry capital's turn to vet whether they are up to standard — how much salary do you want?

text: 你能接受什么尺度？
en: What level of explicitness can you accept?

text: 你这种没有后顾之忧的凭什么和我通过不光彩手段（都不谈非法了，就单纯不光彩）招徕来的这些一屁股债务嗷嗷待哺毫无退路的人竞争？
en: On what basis can someone like you, with no worries to speak of, compete with the people I lure in through inglorious means (never mind illegal — just plain inglorious), people drowning in debt, desperate for relief, with no way out?

text: 到最后，个体经营者要么接受大资本的游戏规则，成为大资本的一部分受到大资本的压榨，要么就会直接被看不见的手一巴掌扫出这个行业。
en: In the end, the individual operator either accepts the rules of big capital, becomes part of big capital and is squeezed by it, or is simply swept out of the industry by the invisible hand.

text: 看到这里，你可能会觉得自己还是受益方，对吗？
en: Seeing this, you might think you are still on the benefiting side, right?

text: 那是因为事到如今，资本在这个行业的扩张还未形成垄断，在其扩张阶段其议价权依旧掌握在市场和散户手里，而一旦个体户被市场手段抹消，大资本完成了对行业中小资产阶级的吞并达到了扩张的极限，那么资本便要露出它的獠牙了。
en: That is because, up to now, capital's expansion in this industry has not yet formed a monopoly; in its expansion phase its bargaining power still lies with the market and retail investors. But once the individual operators are erased by market means and big capital completes its annexation of the small bourgeoisie within the industry, reaching the limit of its expansion, then capital will bare its fangs.

text: 黄色和房地产类似，需求极硬，供给又相当容易控制（虽然理论上来说人人都能卖，但是质量上的差距是巨大的，所以只要控制质量最好的就控制了行业大头），是天然易于垄断的产业，同时也是天然的暴利产业。
en: Porn is like real estate: demand is extremely rigid, and supply is fairly easy to control (although in theory everyone could sell, the quality gap is huge, so whoever controls the highest quality controls the bulk of the industry). It is a naturally easy-to-monopolise industry, and also a naturally hugely profitable one.

text: 一旦这么一个行业完成了自身行业环境的建构，其业内的利润就会天然为其构建起足以影响政策的政治力量。
en: Once such an industry completes the construction of its own operating environment, its internal profits will naturally build up a political force sufficient to influence policy.

text: 到了这一步，寡头便可以一面降质加价，一面以道貌岸然的姿态打压任何竞争对手。
en: At this stage, the oligarchs can both lower quality while raising prices, and suppress any competitor with a sanctimonious posture.

text: 一面“促进行业标准化，规范化”的大牌匾支起来，谁敢反对意见？
en: They hoist up a big plaque proclaiming “promote industry standardisation and normalisation” — who would dare voice opposition?

text: 标准化完了，规范化完了，小个体户彻底散光了，加点价格又有多难？
en: Once standardisation is done and normalisation is done, and the small individual operators are completely gone — how hard is it to add a little to the price?

text: 嫖客会因为一个钟加了三十块不嫖吗？
en: Would a john stop visiting just because a session costs thirty yuan more?

text: 加了一百块他们就不嫖吗？
en: Would they stop at a hundred yuan more?

text: 加三百块，然后给他们便宜大妈又能少掉多少客户？
en: Add three hundred yuan, and then how many customers would they lose by giving them cheap older women?

text: 笑话，房地产翻多少倍了还不是有人买房，无他，马斯洛需求层次到那了耳。
en: Ridiculous. Real estate has multiplied how many times over, and people still buy homes — for no other reason than that Maslow's hierarchy of needs has reached that level.

text: 到那个时候，或许嫖客们会怀念曾经推特空降三千一位的田园牧歌，但是不好意思，再没有推特空降的美好时光了，因为能空降的人里接受得了黄色产业五千一月不包吃住，干得好了一万一月服侍富老头的待遇的人已经在业内了，不在业内的都已经被比曾经还严厉的针对个体户的扫黄和来自合法黄色的竞争干碎了，胜利最终不属于嫖客和妓女的任何一方，胜利只属于资本。
en: By that time, perhaps the johns will nostalgically recall the pastoral idyll of Twitter drop-in girls at three thousand a pop, but sorry, those wonderful Twitter drop-in days are gone for good. Because among those who can do drop-ins, the ones who accept the porn industry's terms — five thousand a month without meals or lodging, and eleven thousand a month serving rich old men if they do well — are already in the industry; those not in the industry have all been crushed by anti-vice sweeps targeting individual operators that are even harsher than before, and by competition from legal pornography. Victory ultimately belongs to neither the johns nor the prostitutes; victory belongs only to capital.

text: 而当垄断的大资本最终将批价哄抬到比如今还高的那一刻，在推动色情合法化中的雪崩中没有一片雪花是无辜的。
en: And at the moment monopolistic big capital finally drives wholesale prices even higher than today, in the avalanche of pushing for the legalisation of pornography, no snowflake is innocent.
